news.title: Mizzou uncovers breakthrough clue to help soybeans fight a billion-dollar pest
news.summary_en: Mizzou researchers study plant resistance to the worms that cause $1 billion in annual losses to U.S. soybean industry.

news.title: Mizzou helps alumna relish her Wienermobile experience
news.summary_en: Spending a year driving the Oscar Mayer Wienermobile gave one alumna a powerful start to her career in public relations.

news.title: Bess Pierce inducted as a fellow of the Veterinary Medicine Academy
news.summary_en: Pierce’s work in rehabilitation, teaching and team-based care is earning national recognition and shaping how the next generation of veterinarians thinks about outcomes.
